theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+1.52%) and Industrials (+1.19%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-1.99%) and Consumer Staples (-0.37%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.18%, defensives -0.23%, and value/cyclicals +0.47% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.71%, Dow +0.29%, Nasdaq +0.83% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.41%. The VIX fell 5.45% to 18.39, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.07% to $4,018.60, crude oil was little changed at $101.48, and bitcoin gained 0.30% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
